text: Peter Geach's doctrine of ___ identity denies that there is any absolute identity relation, holding instead that a and b may be the same F yet not the same G.
explanation: Relative identity holds that identity claims are always relative to a sortal, so 'same lump' and 'same statue' can diverge and there is no framework-independent fact of identity. It offers one response to constitution and Ship-of-Theseus puzzles, but it conflicts with the standard, absolute logic of identity underwritten by Leibniz's Law.
